name: github-app-settings
title: github-app-settings
description: github-app's section of the Settings dialog: Connects the project's GitHub repository in two clicks from the dashboard's Settings → GitHub: a GitHub App created in your account from a manifest and installed on the repository, whose short-lived installation tokens the app mints itself (`github`), its credentials sealed at rest. No token is pasted anywhere. Its settings come with the component (pikit add github-app), stored by settings-store.
